title: Genie track manifest, format 2 (Tynn #1058 L1; L3 added the browser track and withClient)
description: One package of one track (client, host, browser or launcher) for one platform and architecture. Each track updates on its own: a client, browser or launcher package is applied with the host left running; a host package names the client build it ships with (withClient), and the two are applied together. GApps join later as tracks of their own, in a new format. Format 1 was never published. SIGNATURE: Ed25519 over the EXACT bytes of manifest.json (UTF-8, no BOM; never re-serialised before verifying). manifest.json.sig is the 64-byte signature in standard padded base64: 88 ASCII characters on one line, written with no newline; a reader ignores trailing ASCII whitespace (CR, LF, space, tab) and refuses anything else. A public key is the raw 32-byte Ed25519 key in standard padded base64 (44 characters). KEY ROTATION: `nextKey` names the next public key; the manifest's own signature by a trusted key is what vouches for it, so there is no separate nextKeySig. A reader that verified the manifest with a trusted key adds nextKey to its trusted keys. CHECKS, IN ORDER: the signature; the shape below (any unknown field refuses: a new field is a new format; withClient is required of a host and refused for any other track); track, platform, arch and channel are the ones asked for (a stable install takes stable only; dev takes dev and stable); the build is newer than the installed current one (no downgrade; equal refuses); minLauncher is not newer than the running launcher; then every file's size and sha256, with no file missing and none unlisted. Builds and schemas follow test/fixtures/protocol-negotiation.json (trackBuilds, buildOrder). Mirrored in src/core/track-manifest.ts (parseManifest), which test/track-manifest.test.ts holds to this file.

build.description: The track build: <schema>-<release>[.<hotfix>], a real calendar date, release 1 or more. No +metadata in a manifest.

schema.description: The build's schema (its date part), repeated so a reader need not parse the build.

withClient.description: A host package's client build: the client it ships with, applied with it. Required of a host (if/then below), refused for every other track (else).

minLauncher.description: The oldest launcher build that may install this package; null for none.

files.description: Every file of the package, and nothing else (not manifest.json or its .sig). Sorted by path in byte order, strictly ascending; no two paths equal ignoring case (Unicode lower case, as both readers fold; Windows).

path.description: Relative, '/'-separated; no empty, '.' or '..' segment; no backslash, ':' or control character (C0, DEL, C1); at most 1024 UTF-16 code units (both readers count so; maxLength counts code points, so a reader is the stricter).

nextKey.description: Optional. The next Ed25519 public key, raw 32 bytes in standard padded base64.
